title: Open Problems in Integrable Systems — Two-dimensional case.
exact_target: Find a smooth natural system on the sphere whose first nontrivial polynomial integral has degree five and whose potential is not constant.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2100302 (AMR-020-0302). CC BY 4.0.
A. Bolsinov, V. S. Matveev, E. Miranda and S. Tabachnikov, Open Problems, Questions, and Challenges in Finite-Dimensional Integrable Systems (2018), arXiv:1804.03737, Problem 3.5.
